seo.title: Porogaramu Zacu — Isôoko Community Development
seo.description: Isôoko ifite porogaramu eshanu: Guteza imbere Abagore (MWU), Urubyiruko (IZI), Siporo, Ikoranabuhanga, na Tûuza Mubyeyi.

womenEmpowerment.title: Guteza Imbere Abagore
womenEmpowerment.subtitle: Mutima W'urugo (MWU)
womenEmpowerment.desc: Guha ubushobozi abagore bakene kugira ngo bazane impinduka mu mibereho.
womenEmpowerment.intro: Tuwizera ko kuzamuka kw'umugore ari ukuzamuka kw'abaturage. Porogaramu ya MWU igamije guha ubushobozi abagore bakene mu baturage.
offerings: Amatsinda yo kuzigama no kubona inguzanyo
Ubucuruzi n'ubushobozi bwo kugera ku mari

youthEmpowerment.title: Guteza Imbere Urubyiruko
youthEmpowerment.subtitle: Imbaraga z' Isôoko (IZI)
youthEmpowerment.desc: Guha imbaraga urubyiruko mu buyobozi n'ubumenyi.
youthEmpowerment.intro: Akarere ka Masoro gakoresha ubucukuzi bw'amabuye y'agaciro. Urubyiruko ruhura n'ibibazo by'uburezi, ubuzima bwo mu mutwe, n'akazi. Porogaramu ya IZI ikemura ibi bibazo.

sportsWellness.title: Siporo n'Ubuziranutse
sportsWellness.subtitle: Ubuzima bw'umubiri n'ubwo mu mutwe
sportsWellness.desc: Ahantu ho gukora siporo no guteza imbere ubuzima bwo mu mutwe.
sportsWellness.intro: Isôoko Community Center ni ahantu ho gukora siporo no guteza imbere ubuzima bwo mu mutwe.
offerings: Uburezi ku buzima bwo mu mutwe

digitalLiteracy.title: Ikoranabuhanga n'Uburezi
digitalLiteracy.subtitle: Ubumenyi bw'ikoranabuhanga
digitalLiteracy.intro: Isôoko Community Center itanga amahugurwa y'ikoranabuhanga n'uburezi bwo gusoma.

tuuzaMubyeyi.title: Tûuza Mubyeyi
tuuzaMubyeyi.subtitle: Kurera Abana ba Porogaramu
tuuzaMubyeyi.desc: Kurera abana mu gihe ababyeyi bategura ubuzima bwabo.
tuuzaMubyeyi.intro: Porogaramu ya Tûuza Mubyeyi ishyigikira ababyeyi bakene mu gihe bahugurwa kugira ngo bashobore kwiteza imbere.
